posts.title: The Woman in the Watchtower, by Susan Wyndham, wins 2026 Nib Literary Award
posts.description: Sydney based Australian journalist and writer Susan Wyndham (Instagram page), has won the 2026 Mark and Evette Moran Nib Literary Award, for her biography, The Woman in the Watchtower. posts.title: Claude throws a little light on black holes
posts.description: According to Anthropic, their AI agent, Claude, has solved two problems associated with black holes. There’s probably at least another ninety-nine left to work out, but this is a start. The problems in question are theoretical, and Claude’s findings, from what I understand, are yet to be peer reviewed.
